name: cv-manager-public
description: CV Manager - Public Read-Only Interface Share your professional CV safely with this read-only version. Perfect for: • Public exposure via Cloudflare Tunnel • Sharing with recruiters/employers • Portfolio website integration • Job application submissions PUBLIC VERSION - Read-only access. All write operations blocked. Safe to expose publicly. IMPORTANT: Install "CV Manager" (admin) first, then use the SAME appdata path here to share the data. The app auto-detects read-only mode from the volume mount. Default ports: Admin (3000) + Public (3001)

paths.name: AppData
paths.description: Database and uploads storage (read-only). IMPORTANT: Use the SAME path as your CV Manager Admin container!

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Host port for the public interface. Change this to use a different port (e.g. 8080). Do NOT change the PUBLIC_PORT variable below.

variables.name: Public Port (internal)
variables.description: Internal container port. DO NOT CHANGE this value. To use a different port, change the WebUI Port above instead.
